These checksum and detached-signature files are copied unchanged from the public
[Holder 0.2.5 release](https://github.com/HolderTeam/holder/releases/tag/holder-v0.2.5).
They exercise GnuPG verification against `release/keys/holder-linux-release.asc`
without network access. Update the fixture to a matching published signature
when rotating the committed public release key.
